english.note: Use 戰鬥 for an armed battle or combat between opposing forces.
Use this for organized combat or battle rather than an everyday fight.

examples.english: An intense battle broke out at the border between the two countries.
examples.traditional: 兩國喺邊境爆發咗激烈嘅戰鬥。
examples.jyutping: loeng5 gwok3 hai2 bin1 ging2 baau3 faat3 zo2 gik1 lit6 ge3 zin3 dau3

examples.english: The soldiers kept fighting on the front line for several days.
examples.traditional: 士兵喺前線戰鬥咗幾日。
examples.jyutping: si6 bing1 hai2 cin4 sin3 zin3 dau3 zo2 gei2 jat6
